title: LongDocBench: Benchmarking TOC Hierarchy and Contextual Relationship Recovery in Long Documents
abstract: arXiv:2608.15064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parsing visual documents into machine-readable representations is fundamental to document intelligence. Existing benchmarks focus on page-level element recognition, reading order, formula recognition, and table structure. Long documents, however, also require document-level structure recovery. This includes reconstructing cross-page table-of-contents (TOC) hierarchies and identifying typed links from tables and figures to their captions, notes, and sources, often in one-to-many form. Because these structures are covered only partially or subsumed within broader parsing protocols, existing benchmarks cannot directly evaluate two key document-level tasks: \emph{Table-of-Contents Hierarchy Recovery} and \emph{Contextual Relationship Recovery}. To benchmark these two tasks, we introduce \textsc{LongDocBench}, comprising 85 real-world financial reports, textbooks, and academic papers spanning 2,582 pages, with up to 105 pages per document. translated_title: 长文档基准测试：评估长文档中的目录层级与上下文关系恢复
translated_abstract: 将视觉文档解析为机器可读的表示是文档智能的基础。现有基准测试主要关注页面级元素识别、阅读顺序、公式识别和表格结构。然而，长文档还需要文档级结构恢复，包括重建跨页目录（TOC）层级，以及识别从表格和图形到其标题、注释和来源的带类型链接，这些链接通常以一对多的形式存在。由于这些结构在现有基准中仅被部分覆盖或包含在更广泛的解析协议中，现有基准无法直接评估两个关键的文档级任务：\emph{目录层级恢复}和\emph{上下文关系恢复}。为了对这两个任务进行基准测试，我们引入了\textsc{LongDocBench}，包含85份真实世界的财务报告、教科书和学术论文，共2,582页，每份文档最多105页。
tldr: 本文提出了LongDocBench，一个包含85份长文档（共2,582页）的基准测试，专门用于评估跨页目录层级恢复和上下文关系恢复两个文档级任务，弥补了现有基准在这方面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LongDocBench, a benchmark of 85 long documents (2,582 pages) designed to evaluate cross-page TOC hierarchy recovery and contextual relationship recovery, filling a gap in existing benchmarks for document-level tasks.
